faqs.q: Is Sehat AI a replacement for a real doctor?
faqs.a: No — Sehat AI assists triage, recommendations and reporting. Critical care is always escalated to licensed physicians.
English, Hindi, Urdu, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu — more languages are being added regularly.

faqs.q: How is my health data protected?
faqs.a: All data is encrypted and processed under medical-grade privacy standards.

faqs.q: Can Sehat AI book actual hospital appointments?
faqs.a: Yes — our Appointment Agent integrates with partner hospitals to book real slots.
